announcements.text: The auto-switcher is RETIRED and no automation may execute a route switch (owner order 2026-09-18; re-verified 2026-09-26: cron fef19c4f-ab16-442e-8ee9-e041d3d0919b enabled=0, and both sync prompts carry --skip-switch). Do not re-arm either switching path. AMENDED 2026-09-26 — the tier channels this notice named are no longer in the table and the row count has moved: live new_api.channels holds THREE rows (id 43 gemini, status 1 ENABLED, priority 300, auto_ban 1 — re-enabled since the 09-24 read, and that change is UNATTRIBUTED; id 44 iq-75-plus, status 1, priority 200; id 46 iq-80-plus, status 1, priority 210, created 09-25). Because no switch runs, scripts/sync_newapi_channels.py no longer rewrites those rows — so a hand edit to them is PERSISTENT, not transient. That inversion is the thing to know. Channel 43 currently fails 82% of its consumes (871 failures against 197 successes over 8h) and sits first in the priority order, so an `auto` request takes two doomed hops before channel 44 serves; tracked as inferhub-watch #151.
announcements.evidence: Live cron row this turn: inferhub-auto-switcher fef19c4f-ab16-442e-8ee9-e041d3d0919b enabled=0, updated_at 2026-09-18T22:51:42Z (the since value is that row's last change, which is when the retirement landed in the scheduler). scripts/sync_usage_logs.py passes --skip-switch (issue #96), so the in-process switch call is disarmed at the source. scripts/sync_newapi_channels.py writes the tier fields. skills/inferhub/SKILL.md 1.0.30 carries the retirement law.

announcements.text: The ops-profile client fallback chain is now inferhub, openrouter, opencode, gemini — best-first by measured per-hop success rate. It was gemini, opencode, openrouter, inferhub, which put three hops at or below 27.8 percent success ahead of one at 99.1 percent. Any lane running on the ops profile now reaches a provider through this order. The reorder was made live by config hot-reload with no daemon restart.

LIVE ROOT CREDENTIALS ARE COMMITTED in files this factory and infra-factory both touch, and a rotation is pending owner authorisation. /root/inferhub-watch scripts carry the New-API ROOT access token as an os.getenv fallback at three call sites (NEW_API_ROOT_TOKEN is set nowhere, so the committed literal IS the credential in use; verified live - it authenticates as id=1, role=100). The same commit 452b08c8 in leshchenko1979/servers carries THREE more literals at new-api/docker-compose.yml lines 7-11: SQL_DSN (whose password is digest-identical to the PGPASSWORD this factory's own */10 data leg uses), INITIAL_ROOT_ACCESS_TOKEN (its first 32 chars authenticate as root; the full 48-char value is rejected 401), INITIAL_ROOT_PASSWORD (verified a LIVE console login - POST /api/user/login returns success), and SESSION_SECRET (root-equivalent: a holder can mint a valid session cookie for user 1 without presenting any credential). DO NOT edit, rotate or scrub any of these surfaces independently: the change is a five-consumer sequence and a partial rotation produces 401s. Consumers: new-api, grafana (2 datasources), mixpanel-pipeline, ai-antispam, and this factory's data-leg env file. Owner-gated; tracked as inferhub-watch #138. Values are NOT reproduced here - digests only.
